text:
emma: Heads up — NimbusHealth says POC went well and they're ready to sign. They returned an MSA + DPA with redlines and asked to push payment to Net60. Need alignment on prepay, POC SLA wording, and authorized signer. cc @linda @mike @adarsh

linda: Looked at their redlines quickly. They've removed our audit and retention protections and added a mandatory HSM clause. For a short POC we should push back on HSM and preserve limited audit. I can draft a one-page POC addendum that: limits audit to a scoped attestation, sets data deletion timeline, and keeps our production DPA intact.

mike: Procurement note — their procurement team prefers Net60, but Finance default is Net30. For POCs we usually require either prepay or a PO with approved credit. Also need buyer remit address and tax ID on the PO.

olivia: Finance: Net60 is risky without credit review. For a short 2-week POC I can approve Net45 provided we take 50% prepayment. If they insist on Net60 we'll need a formal credit exception and a signed PO.

emma: SE context: POC will run on a small dedicated cluster, expected peak ~50 rps. We shouldn't promise production SLAs. Can we label performance as a "POC performance objective" (non-binding)? @adarsh thoughts on metrics?

adarsh: SE — 50 rps on dedicated is fine. I won't commit to 99.9% SLO for a short trial. Suggest median latency <150ms as the POC objective and include a brief perf-test annex describing test harness and dataset. I'll run a perf test Monday and paste results.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire submitted: https://redwood-secure/qs/3890. They flagged customer-managed HSM requirement. For POC we can provide KMS attestation but not customer HSM.

linda: For signatures, we accept e-sign from an authorized procurement rep plus an attached PO. I'll add to the order form: "Order Form must be signed by an authorized Buyer representative and include Buyer PO# if issued." Also including data deletion 30 days post-POC in the addendum.

mike: To confirm: would Sales accept Net45 + 50% prepay? Customer might ask for milestone payments but that's extra overhead. Also confirming we need W-9 and remit details before issuing invoice.

olivia: Yes — Net45 + 50% prepay is acceptable for this POC once billing contact and PO# are provided. I'll start credit hygiene now; if they push Net60 I'll escalate for a credit exception.

emma: Proposed package to customer: 1) One-page POC addendum limiting data scope and audit; 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45; 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) — median latency 150ms target; 4) E-sign allowed with PO attached. Anyone object?

adarsh: That's fine. I'll attach perf logs after Monday run; if median <150ms we can use that number in the addendum.

linda: I'll draft and circulate the POC addendum today. Removing mandatory HSM for POC and keeping KMS attestation wording.

raj: AE — I'll tell NimbusHealth we require 50% prepay and ask them to send PO to procurement@redwood.example. I'll get the billing contact and tax info.

emma: Action items recap: @linda draft addendum and update DPA; @adarsh run perf Monday; @mike confirm remit/W-9 flow; @olivia approve Net45 + prepay; @raj notify customer. I'll own the e-sign envelope and attach the addendum. :thumbsup:

emma: Order form snippet I plan to send:
```
Term: POC (2 weeks)
Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 from invoice date
SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) — median latency target 150ms
Data: Data deletion within 30 days after POC
```

emma: If anyone has objections to prepay or the non-binding SLA language flag now, otherwise I'll push this to the customer and route for e-sign.
